You might be shedding all sorts of tears over your friend's loss, and that's fine, but if you think that trying to trap him in an existence that he has already deemed unacceptable, would have been a better course of action than letting him take his own life, just so you don't have to mourn, then you are a selfish piece of shit and a horrible friend.

You don't have it any better, you don't have it any worse. You're an irreplaceable human soul with your own unique understanding of what it means to suffer, and that's a huge bummer, but you have to accept and respect the fact that while you think there's always a solution to someone else's problems, that doesn't mean it's an acceptable solution to them. Sometimes it's better to take your life before the liposarcoma does. Sometimes life deals you a shitty hand and you're unjustifiably imprisoned. You probably don't know the true depth to your friend's story.

You must also accept the fact that many people don't consider life to be all that precious and super good, or whatever the fuck your moralistic platitudes have you believe. To those who have broken free of the illusion of humanity's cosmic importance, life is just a thing that happens, and there is no eternal consequence for it one way or another.
